answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can make every identity answer a per-epoch prompt whose three words are seeded from the network's own beacon, then require a quorum of independently established peers to attest that answer before any emission reaches its author. Attack cost then scales with clones: each onyx-seeded prompt must be answered in fresh prose, so a cluster running one model through many wallets still burns one real generation per identity per epoch, and the karst of automation erodes faster than the pooled reward grows.
